 (Under Article 226 of the Constitution of India)
Shaheen ........Petitioner
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Pankaj Singh Chauhan, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Petitioner has sought directions, so that investigation in Fir No.190 of 2022, dated 27.11.2022,
under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A, 376 Ipc and 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police
Station Pulbhatta, District Udham Singh Nagar may be done in accordance with law.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the file.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner had lodged an FIR against her in-laws, in which categorically allegations of rape were leveled against the brother-in-law of the petitioner.
But, it is argued that the police is not conducting investigation fairly.

Therefore,
directions may be issued.
4. Yesterday, when this matter was taken up, learned State Counsel was required to get instructions.
Today, learned State Counsel would submit that the investigation is still in progress.
As per the Investigating Officer ("the IO"), there has been no evidence of rape, but for other offences, the IO is collecting evidence.
5. This Court cannot presume that the investigation is not being done, in accordance with law.
A statement is given on behalf of the State that the IO is taking steps in the direction of investigation.
Therefore, there is no reason to pass any direction at this stage.
Accordingly, the petition deserves to be dismissed.
6. The petition is dismissed.
